title: State Estimation as In-context Tabular Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.32487v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This letter poses state estimation (SE) as an in-context tabular prediction (ICTP) problem. The key idea is a tabular arrangement in which historical measurement vectors and corresponding state estimates serve as the context, and a new measurement vector forms the query for which we predict a state vector. We propose to use tabular foundation models (TFMs), pretrained on synthetic data, whose weights are never updated, so power system data is needed only as context. With frozen TFM weights we estimate the state of 14-, 30-, 33-, 70-, and 118-bus transmission and distribution networks, and do so where weighted least squares (WLS) fails or degrades, under low observability and with bad data. ICTP errors are 11 to 57$\times$ below the per-bus average of the context at full metering, and 1.3 to 4.0$\times$ below it with only 5% of measurements available. translated_title: 将状态估计作为上下文表格预测
translated_abstract: 本信将电力系统状态估计（SE）表述为一个上下文表格预测（ICTP）问题。其核心思想是一种表格化数据组织方式：历史量测向量及对应的状态估计作为上下文，而新的量测向量构成查询，模型据此预测状态向量。我们提出使用在合成数据上预训练的表格基础模型（TFMs），其权重从不更新，因此电力系统数据仅需作为上下文提供。利用冻结权重的TFM，我们对14、30、33、70和118节点的输配电网络进行状态估计，并在加权最小二乘法（WLS）失效或退化的场景下——如低可观测性和存在不良数据时——依然有效。在完全量测条件下，ICTP的误差比上下文中各节点平均误差低11至57倍；在仅有5%量测可用时，误差仍低1.3至4.0倍。当六个节点的量测存在8σ偏差时，ICTP的角度误差上升1.8至（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将电力系统状态估计转化为上下文表格预测问题，利用权重冻结的表格基础模型（仅在合成数据上预训练），在低可观测性、不良数据等加权最小二乘法失效的场景下实现了显著更优的估计精度。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates power system state estimation as an in-context tabular prediction problem, using frozen-weight tabular foundation models pretrained on synthetic data to achieve substantially better accuracy than weighted least squares under low observability and bad data conditions.
